subject: Rally: MAP checkpoint — Oakridge Health procurement/legal runway
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Oakridge Health Procurement <oakridge-procurement@oakridgehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Rally: MAP checkpoint — Oakridge Health procurement/legal runway

Hi Ellen / Oakridge procurement team —

Thanks for carving out time for our weekly MAP checkpoint. Below is a concise status and a proposed rally plan for the next two weeks so we keep the close timeline intact. Please flag anything you disagree with.

Summary (current state)
- MSA: Redwood sent MSA v1 with our standard redlines on 2027-03-05. Oakridge has the file.
- Order Form / PO: Oakridge requested a PO-based order form; draft PO template attached.
- Vendor setup: procurement needs vendor setup requirements (W9, security attestation) — Redwood vendor packet attached.

Open items & owners (ask: confirm owners + ETA)
1) Legal redline review — owner: Oakridge legal / Ellen — ETA requested by 2027-03-14
2) Order form finalization (PO fields + billing contact) — owner: Oakridge procurement — ETA 2027-03-16
3) Vendor onboarding docs submission (W9, SOC2 attestation) — owner: Redwood (Rishi to push certs) and Oakridge vendor portal entry — ETA 2027-03-18
4) DocuSign run (if MSA accepted) — owner: Redwood / Lauren to queue once redlines resolved

Attachments included: Oakridge_MSA_redlines_20270307.docx (our markups), OrderForm_Oakridge_PO_Template.pdf, vendor_onboarding_requirements.xlsx

Proposed meetings
- Short sync (15-20m) on Tue 2027-03-09 to go over redline highlights (Lauren + Ellen + Oakridge counsel)
- Final gating call on Tue 2027-03-16 (30m) to confirm PO/billing and vendor setup status

If that aligns, I’ll send calendar invites and a consolidated action log after the Tue sync.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Oakridge Health Procurement <oakridge-procurement@oakridgehealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rally: MAP checkpoint — Oakridge Health procurement/legal runway

Thanks Kim — quick update ahead of our Tue sync: 

- I reviewed the redlines with legal this morning. High-level: 80% align; three clauses need discussion (data residency carve, indemnity language, and a narrow audit scope). I attached a short comments summary.
- Action: I will pull a 15-min call with Oakridge counsel during the Tue 3/9 short sync to walk the three items.
- Vendor setup: Rishi has the SOC2 + W9 ready; I’ll attach to the vendor portal right after your sync.

On items below I’ve assigned provisional owners/notes:
1) Legal redline review — owner: Ellen / Oakridge counsel (we’ll mark items that are deal-blocking vs negotiable)
2) Order form finalization — owner: Oakridge procurement (please confirm billing contact and PO number format)
3) Vendor onboarding docs submission — owner: Rishi (I’ll upload on 3/9)
4) DocuSign run — owner: Lauren (I’ll prepare envelope; will wait for confirmation post-redline call)

Attachment: Oakridge_MSA_redlines_comments_20270309.pdf

See you on the short sync — I’ll send the calendar invite.

— Lauren
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Ellen Summers <ellen.summers@oakridgehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Oakridge Health Procurement <oakridge-procurement@oakridgehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rally: MAP checkpoint — Oakridge Health procurement/legal runway

Kimberly / Lauren —

Thanks for the compact plan and for the redline summary. Quick reply from Oakridge side: 

- Legal: I reviewed the three flagged clauses with our counsel. We can accept most commercial terms but require edits to the indemnity clause and an explicit audit window of 6 months (our policy). I’ll upload a redline with our proposed language by EOD 3/12.
- PO / Order form: We use a PO number with the format ORG-YY-####. I’ve attached the PO template we prefer. Can you confirm Redwood’s billing contact and the field where PO number should land on the order form?
- Vendor setup: We can accept electronic copies of W9 and SOC2; we’ll process vendor onboarding once we have the W9 + SOC2 link. Expected vendor setup completion is 3–5 business days after submission.

Proposed next milestones
- 2027-03-12: Oakridge redline sent (owner: Ellen)
- 2027-03-16: Final order form + PO format confirmed (owner: Oakridge procurement)
- 2027-03-18: Vendor setup complete and Redwood in vendor registry (owner: Oakridge vendor ops)

Attachment: OrderForm_Oakridge_PO_Template.pdf

Regards,
Ellen Summers
Procurement Manager | Oakridge Health
ellen.summers@oakridgehealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Oakridge Health Procurement <oakridge-procurement@oakridgehealth.com>, Ellen Summers <ellen.summers@oakridgehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rally: MAP checkpoint — Oakridge Health procurement/legal runway

Ellen / team — thanks for the redline and timeline. Quick consolidated status and next steps following our reviews and your submission last week.

Consolidated status (as of today)
- MSA: Oakridge redline received on 2027-03-12. Redwood legal reviewed; we have compromise language proposed for indemnity and a shortened audit scope that preserves your 6-month window while limiting recurring audit frequency. I’ve attached the negotiation summary.
- Order form: Confirmed PO format ORG-27-####. Redwood billing contact: finance@redwood.com (accounts payable). Please place PO in the field labeled "Customer PO Number" on the order form.
- Vendor setup: Oakridge vendor ops confirmed Redwood will appear in registry by 2027-03-18; Rishi uploaded W9 and SOC2 on 2027-03-09.

Outstanding actions (owners & ETA)
- Legal sign-off on compromise language — owner: Oakridge counsel / Ellen — ETA 2027-03-25
- Final DocuSign run (MSA + Order Form) — owner: Lauren — will queue once legal sign-off received
- Vendor onboarding verification (internal check by Oakridge) — owner: Oakridge vendor ops — complete by 2027-03-18 (status: complete)
- Procurement to send final PO to finance@redwood.com after DocuSign (owner: Oakridge procurement)

Next steps I’ll take this week
- Lauren and I will prepare the DocuSign envelope and lock in signature order — hold until 3/25 sign-off.
- I’ll open the HubSpot deal and attach the final negotiation summary and the DocuSign link when live.

If Oakridge can confirm legal sign-off by 3/25 we remain on track for a go-live window in mid-April. If anything slips, please call out the blocker in the thread and we’ll escalate to the legal execs.

Thanks all —
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachments: negotiation_summary_MSA_compromise_20270321.pdf
